query:
SELECT pi.productId, p.name, pi.color, pi.imageUrl, COUNT(*) as image_count
FROM productImages pi
LEFT JOIN products p ON pi.productId = p.id
GROUP BY pi.productId, p.name, pi.color
ORDER BY pi.productId, pi.color;
